name: Ruby CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15

          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: sure_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    env:
      RAILS_ENV: test
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_test

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1

          ruby-version: 3.3

        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Prepare database
        run: |
          bundle exec rails db:create db:migrate
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test

      - name: Precompile assets
        run: bundle exec rails assets:precompile
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test

      - name: Run tests
        run: bundle exec rails test
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test

      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: bundle exec rubocop
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test

yaml:
name: Ruby CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: sure_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    env:
      RAILS_ENV: test
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_test

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.3
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Set up Node (for asset precompilation)
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Prepare database
        run: |
          bundle exec rails db:create db:migrate
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test

      - name: Precompile assets
        run: bundle exec rails assets:precompile
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test

      - name: Run tests
        run: bundle exec rails test
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test

      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: bundle exec rubocop
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test
